CustomField.description: Calculates the Exclusivity Date based on the Lender Account. National Funding = the earlier of the Maturity Date Or Termination Date +365 days Quick Bridge/BizFi = Fund Date + Docs Term + 6 mos SFS/Fora/Knight/ECG/Elevate/OnDeck = Fund Date + Docs Term + 90 days Everest/Forward = Fund Date + Docs Term + 30 days
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'National Funding'), NOT(ISBLANK(NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c)), ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c) ), AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'National Funding'), NOT(ISBLANK(NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c)), NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c <= Termination_Date__c )), NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c+365,
IF( OR( AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'National Funding'), NOT(ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c)), ISBLANK(NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c) ), AND( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name,'National Funding'), NOT(ISBLANK(NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c)), NF_WC_Maturity_Date__c > Termination_Date__c )), Termination_Date__c+365,
IF( AND( DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) < DATEVALUE('2018-06-05'), NOT(ISBLANK(Docs_Term__c)) ), (DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + (VALUE(Docs_Term__c) * (365/12)) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c), IF( NOT( OR( ISBLANK(Docs_Term__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Docs_Payment_Frequency__c)) )), CASE( Docs_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Daily', (DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + ((VALUE(Docs_Term__c)/5)*7) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c), 'Weekly', (DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + (VALUE(Docs_Term__c)*(365/52)) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c), 'Monthly', (DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + (VALUE(Docs_Term__c)*(365/12)) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c), (DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + (365/2) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c) ),
(DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) + (365/2) + Lender_Account__r.Exclusivity_Period__c) ) ) ))
CustomField.label: Exclusivity Date
